SEMANTICS CONTRACT (these definitions are exact; follow them):
- All rules are evaluated once per daily bar, after the close. If today's bar is missing for ANY subscribed ticker, skip ALL rule evaluation for that day (do not crash on missing data).
- "X crosses above Y" means: yesterday X was less than or equal to Y, and today X is greater than Y (both evaluated with that day's values). "Crosses below" is the mirror image. A level being above/below is NOT a cross.
- A "red day" for a ticker means its close is strictly below the PREVIOUS day's close. A "green day" means strictly above. "Red for n consecutive days" is satisfied on any day that completes n or more consecutive red days.
- "d% or more below its highest close of the previous N trading days" compares today's close with the maximum CLOSE over the N days before today (not including today).
- "Gaps down by g% or more" means today's OPEN is at least g% below YESTERDAY's close.
- Each strategy manages its own private lot of shares in its trade ticker: it sells only shares it bought, and its buy reason is evaluated only while its lot is empty; its sell reason only while its lot is non-empty. On any bar, evaluate sells before buys.
- Buy detail "invest p% of portfolio" means set that lot to p% of total portfolio value. Buy detail "buy $C if available" means: if current available cash is at least $C, buy floor($C / close) shares; otherwise do NOTHING this bar (the strategy stays flat; the reason may fire again on a later bar).
- Sell detail "sell half" means sell half of the lot's current shares rounded down (sell the last share when only one remains). A lot is "closed" when it reaches zero shares.
- STATE-GATED template: its strategies may act only while the gate condition is true. On the bar the gate turns false, immediately liquidate every lot held inside the template (including nested templates), clear any race ownership and reset any sequence progress inside it. Market-state quantities (streak counts, rolling highs, indicator values) are always computed from data continuously; gates never pause those computations.
- EVENT-GATED template: when its event condition BECOMES true (true today, false yesterday), the template is ARMED for the next m trading days starting tomorrow. While armed, its strategies may act. When the arming window expires, liquidate every lot inside the template and reset its internal state. A new event edge while armed restarts the window.
- RACE template (first-come-first-served): while no slot owns the template, check each slot's buy reason every bar in slot order; the first slot whose buy reason (including any attached qualifier, checked on that same bar) is satisfied claims sole ownership and executes its buy details. Other slots may not act while ownership lasts. Ownership ends when the owner's lot is closed; the race re-opens the next bar.
- SEQUENCE template: only one slot is eligible at a time, starting with slot 1. A slot becomes ineligible and passes eligibility to the next slot after it completes a full round trip (its lot went from empty to non-empty and back to empty). After the last slot's round trip, eligibility returns to slot 1.
- Do not trade until every indicator or rolling window used by a rule has enough history to be fully formed.

STRATEGY SYSTEM:
One template with 2 slots, no gate. Both slots run independently in parallel.

- Slot 1 - Strategy A (trades SPY):
  - Reason to buy: SPY's close crosses above its simple 100-day moving average.
  - Buy details: invest 40% of total portfolio value in SPY.
  - Reason to sell: SPY's close crosses below its simple 100-day moving average.
  - Sell details: liquidate Strategy A's entire lot.
- Slot 2 - Strategy B (trades AAPL):
  - Reason to buy: AAPL has been red for 3 consecutive days.
  - Buy details: buy $20,000 of AAPL if at least $20,000 cash is available, otherwise do nothing.
  - Reason to sell: AAPL's 14-day RSI closes above 60.
  - Sell details: liquidate Strategy B's entire lot.

Output ONLY the complete Python code in a single ```python code block. No explanation before or after.

Write a complete QuantConnect LEAN algorithm in Python (one class inheriting from QCAlgorithm).

Fixed setup requirements:
- Backtest period: 2006-01-03 through 2015-12-31 (inclusive).
- Starting cash: $1,000,000.
- Subscribe to these US equities at DAILY resolution: "SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG".

Implement EXACTLY the following strategy system. Do not add, remove, or reinterpret any rule.

SEMANTICS CONTRACT (these definitions are exact; follow them):
- All rules are evaluated once per daily bar, after the close. If today's bar is missing for ANY subscribed ticker, skip ALL rule evaluation for that day (do not crash on missing data).
- "X crosses above Y" means: yesterday X was less than or equal to Y, and today X is greater than Y (both evaluated with that day's values). "Crosses below" is the mirror image. A level being above/below is NOT a cross.
- A "red day" for a ticker means its close is strictly below the PREVIOUS day's close. A "green day" means strictly above. "Red for n consecutive days" is satisfied on any day that completes n or more consecutive red days.
- "d% or more below its highest close of the previous N trading days" compares today's close with the maximum CLOSE over the N days before today (not including today).
- "Gaps down by g% or more" means today's OPEN is at least g% below YESTERDAY's close.
- Each strategy manages its own private lot of shares in its trade ticker: it sells only shares it bought, and its buy reason is evaluated only while its lot is empty; its sell reason only while its lot is non-empty. On any bar, evaluate sells before buys.
- Buy detail "invest p% of portfolio" means set that lot to p% of total portfolio value. Buy detail "buy $C if available" means: if current available cash is at least $C, buy floor($C / close) shares; otherwise do NOTHING this bar (the strategy stays flat; the reason may fire again on a later bar).
- Sell detail "sell half" means sell half of the lot's current shares rounded down (sell the last share when only one remains). A lot is "closed" when it reaches zero shares.
- STATE-GATED template: its strategies may act only while the gate condition is true. On the bar the gate turns false, immediately liquidate every lot held inside the template (including nested templates), clear any race ownership and reset any sequence progress inside it. Market-state quantities (streak counts, rolling highs, indicator values) are always computed from data continuously; gates never pause those computations.
- EVENT-GATED template: when its event condition BECOMES true (true today, false yesterday), the template is ARMED for the next m trading days starting tomorrow. While armed, its strategies may act. When the arming window expires, liquidate every lot inside the template and reset its internal state. A new event edge while armed restarts the window.
- RACE template (first-come-first-served): while no slot owns the template, check each slot's buy reason every bar in slot order; the first slot whose buy reason (including any attached qualifier, checked on that same bar) is satisfied claims sole ownership and executes its buy details. Other slots may not act while ownership lasts. Ownership ends when the owner's lot is closed; the race re-opens the next bar.
- SEQUENCE template: only one slot is eligible at a time, starting with slot 1. A slot becomes ineligible and passes eligibility to the next slot after it completes a full round trip (its lot went from empty to non-empty and back to empty). After the last slot's round trip, eligibility returns to slot 1.
- Do not trade until every indicator or rolling window used by a rule has enough history to be fully formed.

STRATEGY SYSTEM:
One template with 2 slots, no gate. Both slots run independently in parallel.

- Slot 1 - Strategy A (trades SPY):
  - Reason to buy: SPY's close crosses above its 200-day simple moving average.
  - Buy details: invest 40% of total portfolio value in SPY.
  - Reason to sell: SPY's close crosses below its 50-day simple moving average.
  - Sell details: liquidate Strategy A's entire lot.
- Slot 2 - Strategy B (trades AAPL):
  - Reason to buy: AAPL has been red for 3 consecutive days.
  - Buy details: buy $20,000 of AAPL if at least $20,000 cash is available, otherwise do nothing.
  - Reason to sell: AAPL's 14-day RSI closes above 60.
  - Sell details: liquidate Strategy B's entire lot.

Output ONLY the complete Python code in a single ```python code block. No explanation before or after.
